rule_or_requirement: A route choice must preserve valid completion and faster lap time from a common visual state, not infer benefit from unmatched full-episode paths.
observable_information: Frozen safe/fast pixel actions and private decision count; evaluation-only matched completion and trajectories.
allowed_action_or_state_change: After 50 identical mode-switch decisions, select the fast pixel action for the remainder; no simulator or map/seed input.
expected_success_endpoint: Fresh matched TRAIN completion rate exceeds unchanged visual mode switch; on a completion tie, median finished lap time improves by at least 2 percent.
control: Exact frozen visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on the same twelve fresh TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Candidate completion lower than control; on tie, median finished lap not at least 2 percent faster; invalid actions, missing post-prefix action changes, or prefix mismatch.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two pixel arms on tracks 1-3 x fresh TRAIN seeds 5052-5055, twenty-four episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU local comparison capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
